newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso trims gains on dollar short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso trims gains on dollar short-covering.

text.p: The Mexican peso ceded some ground gained from the dollar at mid-morning trade on Thursday, due to banks covering short dollar positions amid a thin-volume market, traders said.
"I feel the pesos's advance was excessive...some banks went short on dollars and then had to cover their positions," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 0.65 and 1.3 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.8545/7.8575 and 7.8460/7.8490 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed 2.6 centavos firmer at 7.8430/7.8470 per dollar.
